title: Scrambler 1200 XE (Explorer Pack)
description: Representing Triumph's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Triumph Scrambler 1200 XE (Explorer Pack) is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. A 1200cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
